Big integers work. But peaks are None → some cells unreachable. Because with P=1 and delay 8T → k=8, q=8 → age 16, and dst phase = (0+16)%1 = 0 ✓ so it should be reachable... unless the guard blocks: rho = 0 (O=0, T=S=1e9 → rho = 0), delay = 8e9 > S=1e9 → rho+delay+g ≤ S fails → gmax < 0 → no steps at all! Right: delay ≤ 8T but the guard window requires delay ≤ S - 2g. With S=T, delay=8T → ineligible.

Let me adjust: make S = 10*T so that a delay of 8T fits. Then P = Q*S/gcd(T,Q*S) = 10T/gcd(T,10T) = 10T/T = 10. Hmm, P=10 → V=40.

Let me set T=1e9, S=1e9 (can't: S must be ≥ delay+2g = 8e9). Let me use T=1e8, S=1e9, Q=1 → P = 1e9/gcd(1e8,1e9) = 1e9/1e8 = 10. delay=8*T=8e8 ≤ S ✓. rho_p = (0 + p*1e8) mod 1e9 = p*1e8 → varies 0..9e8 ✓. gmax = min(rho, S-rho-delay) = min(p*1e8, 1e9-p*1e8-8e8) = min(p*1e8, 2e8 - p*1e8) → for p=0: min(0, 2e8) = 0 → only g=0 eligible at phase 0; p=1: min(1e8, 1e8)=1e8 → g ≤ 1e8 ✓.

Also drift = 1e6 + 8*1e6 = 9e6 ppb per interval × T=1e8 ns → 9e14 as per interval. Over 16 intervals → 1.4e16. H ~1e17. Bounds ~1e18. Peak ~1e18 as = 1 ns. Guards: [0, 1e8, 1e9-1]? 2g < S → g < 5e8 ✓.

Let me redo the test to get finite peaks with huge values.
